title: CPC-2008-3470-SP-GPA-ZC-SUD-BL
text:
CPC-2008-3470-SP-GPA-ZC-SUD-BL  Council District: 3 – Blumenfield
  CEQA: ENV-2008-3471-EIR  Last Day to Act: N/A
  Plan Area: Canoga Park – Winnetka – Woodland Hills – West Hills

  PUBLIC HEARING REQUIRED

  PROJECT SITE:
  Warner Center 2035 Specific Plan Area within the Canoga Park – Winnetka – Woodland Hills – West Hills
  Community Plan Area in the west San Fernando Valley.

  PROPOSED PROJECT:
  A Warner Center Cultural Amenities Master Plan (CAMP), pursuant to section 9.6 of the Warner Center 2035
  Specific Plan.

  REQUESTED ACTIONS:
  1. Consider, based on the whole of the administrative record, that the Project was assessed in the previously
  certified Environmental Impact Report No. ENV-2008-3471-EIR and SCH No. 1990011055, prepared for
  the Warner Center 2035 Specific Plan and certified by City Council on October 23, 2013; and pursuant to
  CEQA Guidelines, Sections 15162 and 15164, no subsequent EIR, negative declaration, or addendum is
  required for approval of the Project; and
  2. Pursuant to Chapter 1A Section 13B.1.5 of the Los Angeles Municipal Code and Section 9.6 of the Warner
  Center 2035 Specific Plan, conduct a public hearing on and approve the CAMP.

  Applicant:  City of Los Angeles

  Staff:  Courtney Schoenwald
  courtney.schoenwald@lacity.org
  (818) 374-9916
